tagline: Leading provider of IT solutions and digital engineering services to commercial and government sectors
hero_kpi_rationale: The Bookings KPI is a key driver of the company's growth, reflecting future demand for IT services and demonstrating the ability to win new contracts, particularly within the Commercial consulting segment.

kpis.signal: Stable gross margin despite revenue decline

risks.title: Impairment of goodwill and intangible assets
risks.score_rationale: The risk relates to the assessment of goodwill and intangible assets, which requires complex judgments and estimates. An impairment could have a material impact on financial statements. The strength of language and nature of estimates justify a high severity.

risks.title: Decline in Federal segment revenues
risks.score_rationale: The Federal segment, representing 29.9% of revenues, experienced a 3.3% revenue decline, primarily due to contract losses related to government initiatives (DOGE). The strength of language and revenue decline in this segment justify a moderate severity.

risks.title: Sensitivity to macroeconomic cycles
risks.score_rationale: Revenues from the Commercial segment, more sensitive to economic cycles, declined by 2.7%, with a notable drop in assignment revenues (down 13.8%). The use of the term 'softness' indicates concern regarding current economic conditions.

risks.title: Increase in SG&A expenses
risks.score_rationale: SG&A expenses increased as a percentage of revenues (21.5% vs 20.0%), including $26.5M in acquisition and workforce optimization costs. This rise pressures profitability.

risks.title: Decline in permanent assignment revenues
risks.score_rationale: Assignment revenues declined by 13.8% (from $1,740.5M to $1,500.1M), reflecting weakness in economically sensitive sectors. This significant decline impacts revenue diversification.

risks.title: Dependence on government contracts
risks.score_rationale: The federal segment represents 29.9% of revenues and 26% of revenues come directly from federal government agencies. The loss of contracts tied to government initiatives (DOGE) highlights regulatory or political vulnerability.

risks.title: Increase in debt and interest expenses
risks.score_rationale: Weighted average borrowings increased to $1,210M (vs $1,050M in 2024), leading to higher net interest expenses of $67.7M (vs $64.3M). Debt continues to rise with the acquisition of TopBloc for $304.1M.

ai_positioning.summary: ASGN does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. However, in its new Everforth brand strategy announced in November 2025, AI is listed as one of six key solutions (Data and AI), although without specific investment or usage details in the current 10-K report.
evidence: The new Everforth brand identity includes 'Data and AI' as a key solution area
No mention of AI-related expenses, investments, or initiatives in the MD&A or financial notes
